extraction.notes: No 2027 camp dates or registration milestones were found. Research is limited to the Bryson City programs; Atlanta camps are outside this directory's geographic scope. The two 2026 course-calendar PDFs were only partially readable through the web tool, and PDF screenshots failed, so their summer session dates could not be extracted. The current detailed teen camp page describes only a day camp, although the youth overview pages still mention travel camps. The supplied parent handbook is from 2025; its sample hours were not carried forward to 2026.

cards.name: Kayaking Summer Camp
cards.description: Campers learn kayaking techniques and river-running skills on Western North Carolina lakes and rivers, grouped by paddling experience. The five-day camp ends with Family Fun Friday on the Nantahala.

lunch.text: Daily Lunch included for camper, plus two additional lunches for family members on Family Fun Friday.

cards.review_notes: The undated detailed camp page lists five-day camps in June and July and a starting price of $995; the price is treated as the current 2026 fallback, not a posted 2027 price. Summer session dates in the 2026 calendar PDF could not be read. The detailed page also contains a contradictory generic 18+ eligibility sentence, while its heading and camp-specific eligibility consistently state ages 9–17. The camp page publishes 51 NOC Way; the 2025 handbook and general campus lodging page use 13077 Hwy 19 W / US-19 W for the broader campus.

cards.name: Advanced Teen Kayak Camps
cards.description: Teen kayakers practice advanced river-running techniques, teamwork, river etiquette, and decision-making. The day camp uses the Nantahala River to prepare campers for paddling the Ocoee River.

hours.text: Tuesday through Saturday; camper pick-up around 4:30pm.

lunch.text: Lunch, gear, and area transportation is included along with a Paddling School t-shirt and discounts at our Outfitter’s Store, restaurants, and lodging.

transportation.text: Lunch, gear, and area transportation is included along with a Paddling School t-shirt and discounts at our Outfitter’s Store, restaurants, and lodging.

cards.review_notes: The detailed page is undated; its starting price and hours are treated as current 2026 fallback facts. Its summary says 5–6 days, but its itinerary describes a five-day Tuesday–Saturday day camp, also identified as five days in the 2026 calendar legend. Overview pages mention travel camps, but the detailed page does not currently describe an overnight offering; confirm whether a travel camp remains offered. Summer dates in the calendar PDF could not be extracted. The program page publishes 51 NOC Way, while the older handbook gives the broader campus address of 13077 Hwy 19 W.
